requirement.evidence: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.
requirement.note: Document also states landlords must submit a copy of the notice to quit to the City via portal, report to Fair Housing at 617-635-2500 or 311, and that violation does not halt eviction. Minor nuance: the portal submission is of the Notice to Quit/non-renewal, not of the Rights notice itself.
